description: Create a new template at version 1 from an HTML document with Liquid expressions, plus a JSON Schema for its data. Use this when nothing in list_templates fits. The name must be free on this account — publishing a change to an existing template is `update_template`, not this. Free, but each plan keeps a limited number of templates of your own (the starter library never counts): at the limit this returns `plan_required` with how many the account has, and `update_template` still works.

description.description: One line on what this template is for. Shown in list_templates.

engine.description: Rendering engine. `chromium` (default) is full HTML and CSS and is required for PDF. `satori` is a fast PNG path for simple flexbox card layouts — no page breaks, no floats, no external CSS — and costs us less, so prefer it for OG images and social cards.

example.description: A payload that renders correctly. It is echoed back in validation errors, so include one.

expected_pages.description: How many PDF pages a typical payload renders. Default 1. This is the estimate the free tier and the spend cap are checked against before the render starts, so a template that runs to several pages must say so or a render that cannot fit the allowance will be started and then go over. It is not a limit: the render is billed on the pages it actually produced.

message.description: Change note for this version, like a commit message.

name.description: Template name: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, 1-63 characters. Unique per account. Versions are separate — do not put `@1` here.

options.description: Render options, merged over the template's own defaults. Options are part of the cache key, so two calls that differ only here are two different renders.

background.description: CSS colour painted under the document, e.g. `#ffffff`.

css.description: Extra CSS appended after the template's own styles.

full_page.description: png/jpg: capture the whole document instead of the viewport.

height.description: Viewport height in px for png/jpg. Default 630.

margin.description: PDF margins, CSS lengths in `in`, `px`, `cm` or `mm`: `18mm`, or per side. A bare number is px.

on_blocked_asset.description: What to do when an image or font the template asks for is refused by the egress policy or fails to fetch. `fail` (the default) fails the render with `asset_blocked` naming the URL; `skip` drops the asset and renders without it. Use `skip` only for decorative assets.

print_background.description: PDF: print background colours and images. Default true.

scale.description: Device pixel ratio for png/jpg, 0.1-3. Use 2 for retina.

width.description: Viewport width in px for png/jpg. Default 1200.

schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the `data` payload this template accepts. Strongly recommended: it is what turns a bad payload into a field-level error with a path, an expected type and a working example instead of a blank page. Use `required` and give each property a `description`.

source.description: One self-contained HTML document with inline CSS and Liquid expressions (`{{ customer.name }}`, `{% for line in line_items %}`). No file includes: everything the render needs must be in this string, or at a public https URL. Two extra filters ship by default: `money` and `date_medium`. For a PDF, use `@page { size: Letter; margin: 18mm }` to control pagination.

name: create_template
title: Create a template
